verses.geez: ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ መናሴ ፡ እስመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በኵሩ ፡ ለዮሴፍ ፤
verses.translation: And the borders of the tribe of the children of Manasse, (for he was the first-born of Joseph,) assigned to Machir the first-born of Manasse the father of Galaad, for he was a warrior, were in the land of Galaad and of Basan.

translations.lxx: And the borders of the tribe of the children of Manasse, (for he was the first-born of Joseph,) assigned to Machir the first-born of Manasse the father of Galaad, for he was a warrior, were in the land of Galaad and of Basan.
translations.kjv: There was also a lot for the tribe of Manasseh; for he was the firstborn of Joseph; to wit, for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead: because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan.
translations.ron: De asemenea a căzut, la sorţi, parte şi seminţiei lui Manase, căci acesta era întâiul născut al lui Iosif. Lui Machir întâiul născut al lui Manase, care fusese viteaz în război, i-a căzut Galaadul şi Vasanul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο τὰ ὅρια φυλῆς υἱῶν Μανασσῆ, ὅτι οὗτος πρωτότοκος τῷ Ἰωσὴφ, τῷ Μαχὶρ πρωτοτόκῳ Μανασσῆ πατρὶ Γαλαὰδ, ἀνὴρ γὰρ πολεμιστὴς ἦν, ἐν τῇ Γαλααδίτιδι καὶ ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι.

verses.geez:
ለማኪር ፡ ለበኵሩ ፡ ለመናሴ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ለገላአድ ፡ እስመ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ መስተቃትል ፡ ውእቱ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ገላአድ ፡
                  ወበውስተ ፡ ባሳን ።
verses.translation: And there was land assigned to the other sons of Manasse according to their families; to the sons of Jezi, and to the sons of Kelez, and to the sons of Jeziel, and to the sons of Sychem, and to the sons of Symarim, and to the sons of Opher: these are the males according to their families.

translations.lxx: And there was land assigned to the other sons of Manasse according to their families; to the sons of Jezi, and to the sons of Kelez, and to the sons of Jeziel, and to the sons of Sychem, and to the sons of Symarim, and to the sons of Opher: these are the males according to their families.
translations.kjv: There was also a lot for the rest of the children of Manasseh by their families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh the son of Joseph by their families.
translations.ron: Dar le-au căzut, la sorţi, părţi şi celorlalţi fii ai lui Manase, după familiile lor: fiilor lui Abiezer, fiilor lui Helec, fiilor lui Asriel, fiilor lui Sichem, fiilor lui Hefer şi fiilor lui Şemida. Aceştia sunt fiii lui Manase, fiul lui Iosif de parte bărbătească, după familiile lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη τοῖς υἱοῖς Μανασσῆ τοῖς λοιποῖς κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν· τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰεζὶ, καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Κελὲζ, καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰεζιὴλ, καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Συχὲμ, καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Συμαρὶμ, καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ὀφέρ· οὗτοι ἄρσενες κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ በበሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ኢዬዚ ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ ቄሌዚ ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡
                  ኢዬሪዬል ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ ኢሐኬም ፡ ወለደቂቀ ፡ ዖፌር ፤
verses.translation: And Salpaad the son of Opher had no sons but daughters: and these are the names of the daughters of Salpaad; Maala, and Nua, and Egla, and Melcha, and Thersa.

translations.lxx: And Salpaad the son of Opher had no sons but daughters: and these are the names of the daughters of Salpaad; Maala, and Nua, and Egla, and Melcha, and Thersa.
translations.kjv: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but daughters: and these are the names of his daughters, Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
translations.ron: Iar Salfaad, fiul lui Hefer, fiul lui Galaad, fiul lui Machir, fiul lui Manase, n-a avut fii, ci numai fiice, ale căror nume sunt acestea: Mahla, Noa, Hogla, Milca şi Tirţa.
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ Σαλπαὰδ υἱῷ Ὀφὲρ οὐκ ἦσαν αὐτῷ υἱοὶ ἀλλʼ ἢ θυγατέρες· καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν θυγατέρων Σαλπαάδ· Μααλὰ, καὶ Νουὰ, καὶ Ἐγλὰ, καὶ Μελχὰ, καὶ Θερσά.

verses.translation: And they stood before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua, and before the rulers, saying, God gave a charge by the hand of Moses, to give us an inheritance in the midst of our brethren: so there was given to them by the command of the Lord an inheritance among the brethren of their father.

translations.lxx: And they stood before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua, and before the rulers, saying, God gave a charge by the hand of Moses, to give us an inheritance in the midst of our brethren: so there was given to them by the command of the Lord an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
translations.kjv: And they came near before Eleazar the priest, and before Joshua the son of Nun, and before the princes, saying, The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brethren. Therefore according to the commandment of the LORD he gave them an inheritance among the brethren of their father.
translations.ron: Acestea au venit la preotul Eleazar şi la Iosua, fiul lui Navi, şi la căpetenii şi au zis: "Domnul a poruncit lui Moise să ni se dea parte şi nouă între fraţii noştri". Şi li s-a dat parte, între fraţii tatălui lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔστησαν ἐναντίον Ἐλεάζαρ τοῦ ἱερέως, καὶ ἐναντίον Ἰησοῦ, καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν ἀρχόντων, λέγουσαι, ὁ Θεὸς ἐνετείλατο διὰ χειρὸς Μωυσῆ δοῦναι ἡμῖν κληρονομίαν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν· καὶ ἐδόθη αὐταῖς διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου κλῆρος ἐν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወሰልጰአድ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዖፌር ፡ አልቦ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እንበለ ፡ አዋልድ ፡ ወዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ አስማቲሆን ፡ ለአዋልደ ፡
                  ሰልጰአድ ፡ መሐላ ፡ ወኑኃ ፡ ወሔግላ ፡ ወሜልካ ፡ ወቴርሳ ።
verses.translation: And their lot fell to them from Anassa, and to the plain of Labec of the land of Galaad, which is beyond Jordan.

translations.lxx: And their lot fell to them from Anassa, and to the plain of Labec of the land of Galaad, which is beyond Jordan.
translations.kjv: And there fell ten portions to Manasseh, beside the land of Gilead and Bashan, which were on the other side Jordan;
translations.ron: Şi a căzut lui Manase zece părţi, afară de ţara Galaadului şi a Vasanului, care erau peste Iordan,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔπεσεν ὁ σχοινισμὸς αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Ἀνάσσα, καὶ πεδίον Λαβὲκ ἐκ τῆς γῆς Γαλαὰδ, ἥ ἐστι πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου·

verses.geez:
ወቆማ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እልዐዛር ፡ ካህን ፡ ወቅድመ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ወቅድመ ፡ መላእክት ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ አዘዘ ፡
                  በእደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀበነ ፡ ርስተ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አኀዊነ ፡ ወወሀብዎን ፡ በትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ምስለ ፡
                  አኀዊሁ ፡ ለአቡሆን ።
verses.translation: For the daughters of the sons of Manasse inherited a portion in the midst of their brethren, and the land of Galaad was assigned to the remainder of the sons of Manasse.

translations.lxx: For the daughters of the sons of Manasse inherited a portion in the midst of their brethren, and the land of Galaad was assigned to the remainder of the sons of Manasse.
translations.kjv: Because the daughters of Manasseh had an inheritance among his sons: and the rest of Manasseh’s sons had the land of Gilead.
translations.ron: Pentru că fiicele fiilor lui Manase au primit părţi printre fiii lui, iar rara Galaadului s-a cuvenit celorlalţi fii ai lui Manase.
translations.grk: Ὅτι θυγατέρες υἱῶν Μανασσὴ ἐκληρονόμησαν κλῆρον ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν· ἡ δὲ γῆ Γαλαὰδ ἐγενήθη τοῖς υἱοῖς Μανασσὴ τοῖς καταλελειμμένοις.

verses.geez: ወወድቀ ፡ ሐብሎን ፡ እምነ ፡ ሐናስ ፡ ወሐቅለ ፡ ለቤቅ ፡ እምነ ፡ ገላአድ ፡ ዘማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ።
verses.translation: And the borders of the sons of Manasse were Delanath, which is before the sons of Anath, and it proceeds to the borders even to Jamin and Jassib to the fountain of Thaphthoth.

translations.lxx: And the borders of the sons of Manasse were Delanath, which is before the sons of Anath, and it proceeds to the borders even to Jamin and Jassib to the fountain of Thaphthoth.
translations.kjv: And the coast of Manasseh was from Asher to Michmethah, that lieth before Shechem; and the border went along on the right hand unto the inhabitants of Entappuah.
translations.ron: Hotarul pământului fiilor lui Manase pleca de la Aşer către Micmetat, care e în faţa Sichemului; de aici hotarul merge spre dreapta, până la locuitorii En-Tapuahului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη ὅρια υἱῶν Μανασσῆ Δηλανὰθ, ἥ ἐστι κατὰ πρόσωπον υἱῶν Ἀνὰθ, καὶ πορεύεται ἐπὶ τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ Ἰαμὶν καὶ Ἰασσὶβ ἐπὶ πηγὴν Θαφθώθ.

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ተወርሳ ፡ ርስተ ፡ በማእከለ ፡ አኀዊሆን ፤ ወምድረ ፡ ገላአድሰ ፡ ኮነት ፡ ለደቂቀ
                  ፡ መናሴ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተርፉ ።
verses.translation: It shall belong to Manasse, and Thapheth on the borders of Manasse shall belong to the sons of Ephraim.

translations.lxx: It shall belong to Manasse, and Thapheth on the borders of Manasse shall belong to the sons of Ephraim.
translations.kjv: Now Manasseh had the land of Tappuah: but Tappuah on the border of Manasseh belonged to the children of Ephraim;
translations.ron: Pământul Tapuah a căzut lui Manase; iar cetatea Tapuah, de la hotarul lui Manase, a rămas fiilor lui Veniamin.
translations.grk: Τῷ Μανασσῇ ἔσται· καὶ Θαφὲθ ἐπὶ τῶν ὁρίων Μανασσῆ, τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἐφραΐμ.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ዴላነት ፡ እንተ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሐነት ፡ ወየሐውር ፡ ላዕለ ፡
                  ደወሎሙ ፡ ለኢያሚን ፡ ወውስተ ፡ ኢያሲብ ፡ ዲበ ፡ ነቅዐ ፡ ተፍቶት ።
verses.translation: And the borders shall go down to the valley of Carana southward by the valley of Jariel, (there is a turpentine tree belonging to Ephraim between that and the city of Manasse:) and the borders of Manasse are northward to the brook; and the sea shall be its termination.

translations.lxx: And the borders shall go down to the valley of Carana southward by the valley of Jariel, (there is a turpentine tree belonging to Ephraim between that and the city of Manasse:) and the borders of Manasse are northward to the brook; and the sea shall be its termination.
translations.kjv: And the coast descended unto the river Kanah, southward of the river: these cities of Ephraim are among the cities of Manasseh: the coast of Manasseh also was on the north side of the river, and the outgoings of it were at the sea:
translations.ron: De aici hotarul se pogoară spre râul Cana, pe malul de miazăzi al râului.
translations.grk: Καὶ καταβήσεται τὰ ὅρια ἐπὶ φάραγγα Καρανὰ ἐπὶ Λίβα κατὰ φάραγγα Ἰαριὴλ· τερέμινθος τῷ Ἐφραῒμ ἀναμέσον πόλεως Μανασσῆ· καὶ ὅρια Μανασσῆ ἐπὶ τὸν βοῤῥᾶν εἰς τὸν χειμάῤῥουν· καὶ ἔσται αὐτοῦ ἡ διέξοδος θάλασσα

verses.geez: ለመናሴ ፡ ኮነ ፤ ወጣፌት ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለመናሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ኤፍሬም ።
verses.translation: Southward the land belongs to Ephraim, and northward to Manasse; and the sea shall be their coast; and northward they shall border upon Aseb, and eastward upon Issachar.

translations.lxx: Southward the land belongs to Ephraim, and northward to Manasse; and the sea shall be their coast; and northward they shall border upon Aseb, and eastward upon Issachar.
translations.kjv: Southward it was Ephraim’s, and northward it was Manasseh’s, and the sea is his border; and they met together in Asher on the north, and in Issachar on the east.
translations.ron: Cetăţile acestea sunt ale lui Efraim, deşi sunt între fiii lui Manase. Hotarul lui Manase se sfârşeşte la mare, pe partea de miazănoapte a râului. Partea de miazăzi este a lui Efraim, iar cea de la miazănoapte este a lui Manase. Marea însă era hotarul lor la apus. La miazănoapte se mărginea cu Aşer, iar spre răsărit cu Isahar.
translations.grk: ἀπὸ Λιβὸς τῷ Ἐφραῒμ, καὶ ἐπὶ Βοῤῥᾶν Μανασσῇ· καὶ ἔσται ἡ θάλασσα ὅρια αὐτοῖς· καὶ ἐπὶ Ἀσὴβ συνάψουσιν ἐπὶ Βοῤῥᾶν, καὶ τῷ Ἰσσάχαρ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν.

verses.geez:
ወይወርድ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ ቃራና ፡ ዘኀበ ፡ አዜብ ፡ ወዲበ ፡ ቈላተ ፡ ኢያሪዬል ፡ ዎጤሬምንቶን ፡
                  ዘኤፍሬም ፡ ማእከለ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ወደወሉሂ ፡ ለመናሴ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ መስዕ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ፈለግ ፡ ወኮነ ፡ ሞጻእቱ
                  ፡ ባሕር ፤ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡ አዜቡ ፡ ለኤፍሬም ፡ ወእንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መስዑ ፡ ለመናሴ ፡ ወባሕር ፡ ወሰኖሙ ፡ [ወበአሴር ፡
                  ይትራከቡ ፡ በመስዕ ፡ ወበይሳኮር ፡ እምጽባሕ ።] ወይከውን ፡ ለመናሴ ፡ በይሳኮር ፡ ወበአሴር ፡ ወቶሐን ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሆን ፡
                  ወእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዶር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሃ ፡ ወእለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጌዶ ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሃ ፡ ወሣልስተ ፡ እዴሃ ፡
                  ለመ[ፌ]ታ ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሃ ።
verses.translation: And Manasses shall have in the portion of Issachar and Aser Bæthsan and their villages, and the inhabitants of Dor, and its villages, and the inhabitants of Mageddo, and its villages, and the third part of Mapheta, and its villages.

translations.lxx: And Manasses shall have in the portion of Issachar and Aser Bæthsan and their villages, and the inhabitants of Dor, and its villages, and the inhabitants of Mageddo, and its villages, and the third part of Mapheta, and its villages.
translations.kjv: And Manasseh had in Issachar and in Asher Bethshean and her towns, and Ibleam and her towns, and the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Endor and her towns, and the inhabitants of Taanach and her towns, and the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns, even three countries.
translations.ron: În Isahar şi Aşer sunt ale lui Manase: Bet-Şean cu locurile care se ţin de el, Ibleam cu locurile care se ţin de el, locuitorii din Dor şi din locurile care lin de el, locuitorii din En-Dor şi locurile care ţin de el, locuitorii din Taanac şi locurile care ţin de el, locuitorii Meghidonului şi locurile care ţin de el, şi a treia parte din Nafet cu satele lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσται Μανασσῇ ἐν Ἰσσάχαρ καὶ ἐν Ἀσὴρ Βαιθοὰν καὶ αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Δὼρ, καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς, καὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας Μαγεδδὼ, καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς, καὶ τὸ τρίτον τῆς Μαφετὰ, καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወስእኑ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ መናሴ ፡ አጥፍኦቶን ፡ ለእላንቱ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ወመጽኡ ፡ ከናኔዎን ፡ ይንበሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡
                  ምድር ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Manasse were not able to destroy these cities; and the Chananite began to dwell in that land.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Manasse were not able to destroy these cities; and the Chananite began to dwell in that land.
translations.kjv: Yet the children of Manasseh could not drive out the inhabitants of those cities; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
translations.ron: Fiii lui Manase n-au putut alunga pe locuitorii acestor oraşe şi Canaaneii au rămas să locuiască în ţara lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Μανασσῆ ἐξολοθρεῦσαι τὰς πόλεις ταύτας· καὶ ἤρχετο ὁ Χαναναῖος κατοικεῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ.

verses.geez: ወጸንዕዎሙ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወቀነይዎሙ ፡ ወአጥፍኦ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ኢያጥፍእዎሙ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass that when the children of Israel were strong, they made the Chananites subject, but they did not utterly destroy them.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass that when the children of Israel were strong, they made the Chananites subject, but they did not utterly destroy them.
translations.kjv: Yet it came to pass, when the children of Israel were waxen strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, but did not utterly drive them out.
translations.ron: Când fiii lui Israel au ajuns puternici, atunci Canaaneii au fost făcuţi birnici ai lor, dar de alungat nu i-au alungat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγενήθη καὶ ἐπεὶ κατίσχυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ, καὶ ἐποίησαν τοὺς Χαναναίους ὑπηκόους, ἐξολοθρεῦσαι δὲ αὐτοὺς οὐκ ἐξωλόθρευσαν.

verses.geez:
ወተዋሥእዎ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ [ለኢየሱስ ፡] ወይቤልዎ ፡ በበይነ ፡ ምንት ፡ አውረስከነ ፡ አሐደ ፡ ርስተ ፡ ወአሐደ ፡
                  ሐብለ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ አነ ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር ፡ ባረከኒ ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Joseph answered Joshua, saying, Wherefore hast thou caused us to inherit one inheritance, and one line? whereas I am a great people, and God has blessed me.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Joseph answered Joshua, saying, Wherefore hast thou caused us to inherit one inheritance, and one line? whereas I am a great people, and God has blessed me.
translations.kjv: And the children of Joseph spake unto Joshua, saying, Why hast thou given me but one lot and one portion to inherit, seeing I am a great people, forasmuch as the LORD hath blessed me hitherto?
translations.ron: Fiii lui Iosif au zis către Iosua: "Pentru ce ne-ai dat o singură parte şi un singur sorţ, când noi suntem mulţi, de vreme ce ne-a binecuvântat aşa Domnul?"
translations.grk: Ἀντεῖπαν δὲ οἱ νἱοὶ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ Ἰησοῦ, λέγοντες, διατί ἐκληρονόμησας ἡμᾶς κλῆρον ἕνα, καὶ σχοίνισμα ἕν; ἐγὼ δὲ λαὸς πολύς εἰμι, καὶ ὁ Θεὸς εὐλόγησέ με.

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ዕረጉ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኦም ፡ ወአንጽሕዎ ፡ ለክሙ ፡ እመ ፡ ይጸብበክሙ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ኤፍሬም ።
verses.translation: And Joshua said to them, If thou be a great people, go up to the forest, and clear the land for thyself, if mount Ephraim be too little for thee.

translations.lxx: And Joshua said to them, If thou be a great people, go up to the forest, and clear the land for thyself, if mount Ephraim be too little for thee.
translations.kjv: And Joshua answered them, If thou be a great people, then get thee up to the wood country, and cut down for thyself there in the land of the Perizzites and of the giants, if mount Ephraim be too narrow for thee.
translations.ron: Şi Iosua le-a răspuns: "Dacă sunteţi mulţi, duceţi-vă în păduri şi acolo, în ţara Ferezeilor şi Refaimilor, căutaţi-vă loc, dacă muntele Efraim vă e strâmt!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰησοῦς, εἰ λαὸς πολὺς εἶ, ἀνάβηθι εἰς τὸν δρυμὸν, καὶ ἐκκάθαρον σεαυτῷ εἰ στενοχωρεῖ σε τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ἐφραΐμ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሉ ፡ ኢየአክለነ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወከናኔዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስቴቱ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ አፍራሰ ፡ ኅሩየ ፡ ወኀፂነ
                  ፡ በቤቴስ ፡ ወበአዕጻዲሃ ፡ በቈላተ ፡ [ኢይዝ]ራኤል ።
verses.translation: And they said, The mount of Ephraim does not please us, and the Chananite dwelling in it in Bæthsan, and in its villages, and in the valley of Jezrael, has choice cavalry and iron.

translations.lxx: And they said, The mount of Ephraim does not please us, and the Chananite dwelling in it in Bæthsan, and in its villages, and in the valley of Jezrael, has choice cavalry and iron.
translations.kjv: And the children of Joseph said, The hill is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites that dwell in the land of the valley have chariots of iron, both they who are of Bethshean and her towns, and they who are of the valley of Jezreel.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Iosif au zis: "Muntele nu va rămâne al nostru, pentru că toţi Canaaneii care locuiesc în vale au căruţe de fier, atât cei din Bet-Şean şi din locurile care ţin de ea, cât şi cei din şesul Izreel".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπαν, οὐκ ἀρέσκει ἡμῖν τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ἐφραΐμ· καὶ ἵππος ἐπίλεκτος, καὶ σίδηρος τῷ Χαναναίῳ τῷ κατοικοῦντι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐν Βαιθσὰν, καὶ ἐν ταῖς κώμαις αὐτῆς, ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι Ἰεζραέλ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ዮሴፍ ፡ እመ ፡ ብዙኅ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ አንተ ፡ ወብከ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ ኀይለ ፡ ኢይከውነከ ፡
                  አሐዱ ፡ ርስት ።
verses.translation: And Joshua said to the sons of Joseph, If thou art a great people, and hast great strength, thou shalt not have only one inheritance.

translations.lxx: And Joshua said to the sons of Joseph, If thou art a great people, and hast great strength, thou shalt not have only one inheritance.
translations.kjv: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot only:
translations.ron: Dar Iosua a zis către casa lui Iosif, lui Efraim şi lui Manase: "Tu eşti mult la număr şi ai putere multă. Deci nu vei avea numai o parte.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰωσὴφ, εἰ λαὸς πολὺς εἶ καὶ ἰσχὺν μεγάλην ἔχεις, οὐκ ἔσται σοι κλῆρος εἷς·

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ ሐቅል ፡ ለከ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ ገዳም ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወታነጽሖ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወይከውነከ ፡ እስከ ፡ ታጠፍኦሙ ፡
                  ለከናኔዎን ፡ እስመ ፡ አፍራሰ ፡ ኅሩየ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ወለሊከ ፡ አጽናዕካሆሙ ።
verses.translation: For thou shalt have the wood, for there is a wood, and thou shalt clear it, and the land shall be thine; even when thou shalt have utterly destroyed the Chananite, for he has chosen cavalry; yet thou art stronger than he.

translations.lxx: For thou shalt have the wood, for there is a wood, and thou shalt clear it, and the land shall be thine; even when thou shalt have utterly destroyed the Chananite, for he has chosen cavalry; yet thou art stronger than he.
translations.kjv: But the mountain shall be thine; for it is a wood, and thou shalt cut it down: and the outgoings of it shall be thine: for thou shalt drive out the Canaanites, though they have iron chariots, and though they be strong.
translations.ron: Muntele va fi al tău şi pădurea. Tu îl vei curăţi şi va fi al tău până la capătul lui, căci tu vei izgoni pe Canaanei, deşi ei au căruţe de fier; deşi ei sunt tari, tu îi vei birui".
translations.grk: Ὁ γὰρ δρυμὸς ἔσται σοι, ὅτι δρυμός ἐστι καὶ ἐκκαθαριεῖς αὐτὸν, καὶ ἔσται σοι· καὶ ὅταν ἐξολοθρεύ· σῃς τὸν Χαναναῖον, ὅτι ἵππος ἐπίλεκτος αὐτῷ ἐστι· σὺ γὰρ ὑπερισχύεις αὐτοῦ.
